question: What worship should be performed on yoga-occasions?
premises: Body-worship should certainly be performed on a yoga-occasion.
A wise person should honor all days called yoga-occasions.
This honoring is done through body-worship.
inference: The prescribed observance for every yoga-occasion is body-worship performed by the wise practitioner.
uncertainties: The exact ritual content of mūrtiyāga (body-worship) is not specified in this verse.
plain_english: On a yoga-occasion, body-worship should be performed in every way. A wise person should honor all days known as yoga-occasions through this worship.
